In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the dynamics of nuclear reactions of neutron-rich nuclei at the energy of vanishing transverse collective flow.

the investigation of the nuclear dynamics of the neutron-rich colliding pairs at the incident energy where the collective transverse flow vanishes, i.e., the energy of vanishing transverse flow (Ebal) of the system.
the study of the density and temperature of nuclear matter in neutron-rich collisions at the energy of vanishing in-plane flow.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the isovector flow is not a good probe for the symmetry energy at low incident energies and for the colliding pairs with small mass asymmetries, while it can be a good probe for large mass asymmetries at higher energies.
the nuclear equation of state (EoS) and in-medium N-N cross section play a major role in the disappearance of collective transverse in- plane flow.
the neutron-rich matter at the energy of vanishing collective transverse inplane flow (Ebal) has a density of 0.1 fm-3 and temperature of 10 MeV.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the density and temperature at Ebal is not much affected by isospin degree freedom.
isospin degree has a significant role in the nuclear dynamics.
isospin dependence of nuclear dynamics is very important at low energy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the density and temperature in a heavy-ion reaction at Ebal are found to be highly sensitive on the colliding geometry.
isospin effects are important at Ebal and they are not only limited to collective flow and its energy dependence.
the density and temperature at the balance energy is very high and it is almost independent of the colliding pair and the system size.
